description: Delete specific relations (from, to, relationType) from the knowledge graph and keep the entities they connect. Each relation must match an existing one exactly on all three fields; if unsure, call open_nodes (or search_nodes) first to read the stored relationType. Use it to remove a link between two entities; to remove an entity itself, use delete_entities. Cannot be undone.

relations.description: An array of relations to delete

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

name: delete_relations
title: Delete Relations
